text: its not xray then. why else would it be translucent. its not glass, glass is blue
resolution: Root-caused the 'permanent xray' ghost: it was never the X-Ray toggle. Reference backdrop trace planes (req_2758) persisted under ONE global localstore key (editor/model-backdrops), so planes added while tracing any model rendered forever in every model viewer as translucent grey quads — blank when their cached image was gone, a thin tick-marked line when seen edge-on — matching the screenshot exactly. Saved docs were verified opaque (glassFirstVertex == vertCount), ruling out glass/atlas alpha. Fix: backdrops now key per document (model-backdrops:<docId> from the same identity the hot-resume twig uses); the old global key is no longer read, so the haunting planes vanish everywhere while each model keeps only its own traces. ModelView bundles clean; hot reload applies.
